# A structured evaluation framework

## Learning objective
Apply one framework consistently across all cases.

## Content to develop
- Inspect the question and intended scope.
- Check data, design, methods, and assumptions.
- Verify code, outputs, and reported quantities.
- Assess biological interpretation and uncertainty.
- Explain corrections and their consequences.

## Practice task
Use the rubric and evidence log to assess one claim; distinguish the quality of your review from the severity of the analytical error.

## Checkpoint
Can another reader trace each conclusion to evidence and understand what remains uncertain?

## Deliverable
A scored review supported by an evidence log.
